log: |rule|Species Clause: Limit one of each Pokémon

decisions.thought: Gholdengo lead blanks Fake Out with Ghost-typing and Parting Shot with Good as Gold, avoiding the worst bad matchup. Incineroar gives Intimidate pivot and Dragonite gives Multiscale setup with Ice Punch for opposing Garchomp and Dragonite.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating speed, knockout potential, and matchup to select the single best legal action per rules.Parsing the truncated team list and applying the bring-three selection constraint.Evaluating the mirror matchup to identify the optimal three-Pokemon selection and lead priority.Comparing Dragonite, Garchomp, Primarina, and Kingambit for the third slot and lead sequencing against Gholdengo.

decisions.thought: Gholdengo is slower than Garchomp and faces a bad matchup, likely to be knocked out by Earthquake before it moves. Dragonite is immune to Ground and threatens a knockout with Ice Punch.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating turn decision for level 50 Pokémon Champions singles under speed, knockout, and matchup constraints.Assessing legal actions and team preview constraints for the current turn state.Evaluating switch options against the faster opponent’s likely super effective ground move.

decisions.thought: Ice Punch is 4x super effective and should knockout Mega Garchomp. Dragonite is at full HP so Multiscale guarantees surviving any attack first.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Dragonite versus Mega Garchomp speed and damage to decide between Ice Punch and alternative moves.Assessing Mega Evolution ability loss versus Multiscale protection for the immediate KO decision.

decisions.thought: Dragonite is in a bad matchup to switch out of, facing likely Fairy STAB it is weak to at 44% HP. It cannot knockout Primarina from full with resisted or neutral coverage. Gholdengo resists Fairy and threatens back.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing Pokémon battle rules and constraints to select the single best legal action for the turn.Evaluating mega evolution timing and priority against the opponent's unknown ability and remaining team.Switching to Gholdengo for the type matchup while preserving Dragonite.

decisions.thought: Both Incineroar and Dragonite are weak to Primarina's Water/Fairy STAB, so switching is a bad matchup. Staying with Gholdengo walls Moonblast. Shadow Ball gives consistent STAB with no Sp. Atk drop and hits a possible opposing Gholdengo super effectively.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing Pokémon type matchups and turn options to pick the optimal move given HP and team states.Verifying Steel and Ghost defensive resistances against Water and Fairy attacks.Evaluating Gholdengo's move options against Primarina while weighing damage, setup risk, and potential Water coverage.Comparing Shadow Ball and Make It Rain for Primarina while weighing STAB damage versus the special attack drop and switch matchups.

decisions.thought: Gholdengo will faint to any attack, so staying is a gamble on a knockout. Make It Rain is super effective versus Fairy and should finish the 59% Primarina if Gholdengo moves first.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Following the Pokémon Champions rules to select the single best turn action with concise reasoning.Evaluating legal actions against the opponent's remaining options under the single-turn constraint.Calculating damage and speed ranges to rule out staying in versus switching.

decisions.thought: Primarina is at 5% so priority will guarantee the knockout before it moves. Incineroar is full HP while Dragonite is low, so preserve Dragonite.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating which Pokémon to send in by comparing priority moves against a near-fainted opponent and the unknown remaining team.Comparing priority KO options and HP preservation against the unknown last Pokémon.

decisions.thought: Primarina is at 5% HP, so priority Fake Out guarantees the knockout. It avoids a speed roll and keeps Incineroar at full health for the last matchup.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Fake Out KO and turn order to confirm the safe win versus Primarina.

decisions.thought:
Incineroar is slower and Flare Blitz is not very effective, so staying in is a bad matchup. Opponent Dragonite threatens to set up or KO.
Parting Shot lowers its offenses and pivots to our Dragonite with Ice Punch.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing Pokemon battle state and damage to infer Dragonite's ability between Multiscale and Inner Focus.Evaluating damage and flinch outcomes to distinguish Multiscale from Inner Focus.

decisions.thought: Incineroar is in a bad matchup to switch out of against Earthquake Dragonite. Switching to Dragonite is the only legal action and preserves momentum.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating speed, knockout potential, and matchup to select the single best legal action within format constraints.Assessing unknown ability and item to choose the safest move against the faster opposing dragonite.

decisions.thought: Opposing Dragonite is 4x weak to Ice and already chipped to 92%, so Ice Punch is a likely knockout. My Dragonite is max speed and immune to its revealed Earthquake, and Mega evolving secures power and stats to move first.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing turn constraints for Pokémon Champions singles, prioritizing speed, knockout, or matchup to select one legal action.Evaluating legal actions against opponent stats and speed to choose a safe move.Balancing Ice Punch KO chance against speed tie risk and Extreme Speed priority safety.Evaluating Mega Evolution bulk and priority against a weakened opponent switch-in.

decisions.thought: We outspeed Primarina and it is at 5% HP, so this is a guaranteed knockout to win the game. ExtremeSpeed's priority guarantees we move first.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating move options for a faster Dragonite versus low-HP Primarina to ensure a guaranteed KO.Assessing ExtremeSpeed priority and Focus Sash edge cases for the guaranteed KO.
